name: Booking
description: Full appointment booking — services with categories, locations, resources, add-ons, per-staff pricing and group price tiers; staff schedules with breaks and date overrides; group + recurring + walk-in bookings; an embeddable /book widget with custom fields and self-service cancel/reschedule; configurable email + SMS/WhatsApp reminders, per-service templates and follow-ups; customer profiles with no-show, loyalty and tags; and payments via Stripe (full or deposit), coupons, gift cards, tax, refunds and invoices.
author: Slate

Create / edit / delete providers, hours, breaks, overrides
Manage coupons, gift cards, refunds + invoices
